description.value:
Duration permanent

You learn your bound spirit's true name. Your Fraying die drops one step permanently while that spirit is the one bound to you — this stacks with the improvement at 7th level. The spirit may still refuse an ask, but it can no longer feign ignorance of you: it may never make you repeat, rephrase, or re-establish who you are, and effects that would sever or confuse your bond take a status penalty against you.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Fraying die drops one step permanently" needs Fraying to have rule-element representation to modify. "Effects that would sever or confuse your bond take a status penalty" needs a defined trait/tag for "bond-severing" effects -- no card in this corpus tags any effect that way, so there is no predicate to hook a FlatModifier to. Hollowbound's entire Toll / Fraying / Quiet-Unveiled / Parley system has zero rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus -- classes.hollowbound.json ships system.rules: [] and defines the whole subsystem only in flags.cinderfall prose (the terms array and progression table). Confirmed via grep -rli "SpecialResource" across feats/class/hollowbound/ and classes.hollowbound.json -> zero matches. Note: SpecialResource with renew:false IS a real, precedented mechanism for a manually-tracked, non-daily-refilling pool (confirmed live in this very corpus at feats/class/fleshmancer/fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json, max:10, renew:false) -- so this is not an engine limitation, but there is no equivalent "Toll Pool"-style classfeature card anywhere in feats/class/hollowbound/ to attach such a rule element to; a card would need to be authored first, which is out of scope for a gap-filling pass over the existing 75 cards.
